name: University of Evansville
academic_ranking: Private United Methodist-affiliated university founded in 1854. Enrollment ~2,100 (about 1,740 undergraduates) with 80+ majors across four colleges. Admissions described as 'more selective.' Historically ranked among the top regional universities in the Midwest by U.S. News & World Report (e.g., #7 regional Midwest, #12 for value in 2022). Known for its Harlaxton College study-abroad program in England.
financial_aid: Private institution with published undergraduate tuition and fees of $44,172 (2024-2025, IPEDS/College Navigator ID 150534). Institution offers merit- and need-based aid; specific softball scholarship figures not publicly listed on program pages. Prospective student-athletes should confirm packages with the UE financial aid office and coaching staff.
facilities_notes: Purple Aces softball competes as an NCAA Division I program within the Missouri Valley Conference. Specific softball facility details (stadium name, seating, indoor training) were not confirmed on the fetched program pages; verify directly with the athletics department.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I women's softball program competing in the Missouri Valley Conference under head coach Bailey Dillender. Coaching staff comprises a head coach, associate head coach, and assistant coach supported by athletic training staff.
notes: Data gathered live from gopurpleaces.com softball coaches and roster pages on 2026-07-30. Roster of 24 players confirmed by counting the 2026 roster listing (jersey numbers 1-44). Tuition sourced from NCES College Navigator (IPEDS ID 150534, 2024-2025: $44,172). Academic/profile details from Wikipedia. No coach phone numbers or Twitter/X handles were publicly listed on the staff directory.
